macro.title: Anthropic Pre-IPO Credit Facility Set to Climb Past $10 Billion - Bloomberg
macro.summary: Anthropic PBC’s revolving credit facility is set to rise above its roughly $10 billion target, according to people familiar with the matter, as the artificial intelligence firm prepares for a highly anticipated initial public offering.

macro.title: Diesel Margins Top $100 a Barrel to Reach Record High as Supply Crunch Grows - Bloomberg
macro.summary: The margin for making diesel from crude oil in the US has soared to more than $100 a barrel, setting new all-time highs as a global fuel-making crunch continues to exacerbate fuel prices.

macro.title: S&P 500 falls, hurt by elevated global bond yields and oil prices: Live updates - CNBC
macro.summary: The S&P 500 fell on Tuesday, pressured by a run in sovereign bond yields to multidecade highs amid concerns of persistent inflation and elevated oil prices.
